title: Throwin Peeps
description: A plugin for beta 1.7.3 Minecraft that allows you to pick up and throw players!
body:
A simple and silly plugin for Beta 1.7.3 Minecraft that allows players to pickup and throw other players.

The plugin uses the permission node ```throwinpeeps.toggle``` to see who is elliglbe to throw players.</br>
```/throwinpeeps``` toggles thew ability to throw on.
